name: koenami
description: Japanese-first voice practice with audible references and a live acoustic map

scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && vite build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.svelte-kit/cloudflare/BUILD','minified')"
scripts.build:coverage: bun run build:wasm && KOENAMI_COVERAGE=1 vite build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.svelte-kit/cloudflare/BUILD','coverage')"
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build measure --target web --release --out-dir ../src/lib/measure/pkg --out-name koenami_measure --no-default-features --features wasm
scripts.check: bun run build:wasm && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsgo --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run check:tests && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build:coverage && bun run test:unit:coverage && E2E_COVERAGE=1 bun run test:e2e && bun run coverage:report
